column1:
{0}{1}
{2}
schema:
  schema_id: {3}
  language: zh
  input_scheme: double_pinyin
  name: {4}
  version: "1"
  description: |
    CyIME 双拼方案（由键位表生成）的九键版本：每个字按它的两个双拼键所在的数字键输入。
  dependencies:
    - cyime_t9_english

switches:
  - name: ascii_mode
    reset: 0
    states: [ 中文, 西文 ]
  - name: full_shape
    states: [ 半角, 全角 ]
  - name: ascii_punct
    reset: 0
    states: [ 。，, ．， ]

engine:
  processors:
    - t9_processor
    - ascii_composer
    - recognizer
    - key_binder
    - speller
    - punctuator
    - selector
    - navigator
    - express_editor
  segmentors:
    - ascii_segmentor
    - matcher
    - abc_segmentor
    - punct_segmentor
    - fallback_segmentor
  translators:
    - punct_translator
    - script_translator
    - t9_english_translator@t9_english
  filters:
    - cyime_candidate_policy
    - t9_filter
    - uniquifier

speller:
  alphabet: zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba9876543210{5}
  initials: zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba9876543210
  delimiter: " '"
  algebra:
{6}
translator:
  dictionary: rime_ice
  prism: {7}
  max_homophones: 32
  spelling_hints: 100
  always_show_comments: true
  comment_format: []

t9:
  # 左侧拼音栏的读音由输入法按本方案的两个键算（NineKeyFuzzyReadings），引擎只负责点选后锁定；
  # 以前写 none，没开模糊音时双拼九键没有拼音栏，选不了读音（11-15）。候选上方按双拼两键一字显示拼音。
  left_panel_mode: pinyin
  double_pinyin: true
  isDisplayOriginalPreedit: false

cyime:
  candidate_policy: true

punctuator:
  import_preset: default

recognizer:
  patterns:
    punct: "^/([0-9]|10|[A-Za-z]*?){8}"

key_binder:
  bindings:
    - { when: has_menu, accept: 1, send: apostrophe }

editor:
  bindings:
    space: confirm

t9_english:
  dictionary: cyime_t9_english
  enable_completion: false
  enable_sentence: false
  enable_user_dict: true
  initial_quality: 0.2
  comment_format: []
  digit_suffixes: false
  completion_limit: 3

column1: CyIME 默认使用本地输入与识别。主动启用在线语音或其他联网服务时，相应音频或文本会发送给您选择的服务商。手写贡献和贡献滑行轨迹须同意 CC0 1.0 才能向魔搭上传。手写包含题目、笔迹、时间、识别结果（如有）、机型、版本及随机编号。滑行只在「贡献滑行轨迹」页开启贡献时发送题目、布局、轨迹及随机编号，平时打字不记录。贡献样本可公开使用。在「贡献词库」页分享或上传时，只有列表里勾选的词、拼音和次数，用于改进 CyIME 词库。平时手写和打字的原文不会上传。
column2: CyIME uses on-device input and recognition by default. When you turn on online voice or other network services, the related audio or text is sent to the provider you choose. Handwriting and glide-path contributions require agreeing to CC0 1.0 before uploading to ModelScope. Handwriting includes prompts, strokes, timing, recognition results (if any), device model, version and a random ID. Glide data is only sent when contribution is turned on in “Contribute glide paths”, with prompts, layout, paths and a random ID; everyday typing isn't recorded. Contributed samples may be used publicly. When sharing or uploading from “Contribute dictionary”, only the ticked words, pinyin and counts in the list are sent, to improve CyIME's dictionary. What you normally handwrite and type is never uploaded.

column1: CyIME 默认在本地存储设置、词库和剪贴板历史。主动启用剪贴板同步插件时，剪贴板内容会按插件配置传输；备份只导出到您选择的本地文件。您可以随时清除本地数据。
column2: CyIME stores settings, dictionaries and clipboard history locally by default. When you turn on a clipboard sync plugin, clipboard content is transferred as that plugin is configured; backups are only exported to local files you choose. You can clear local data at any time.

column1: 网络权限用于下载输入方案和模型、检查和下载新版本，以及您主动启用的在线服务。检查更新只向 GitHub 查询版本号，不发送输入内容；只有您点「检查更新」或打开「自动检查更新」时才联网查询，新版本由系统安装程序安装。本地 Rime、手写和离线语音模型在设备上运行。
column2: Network permission is used to download input schemes and models, check for and download new versions, and for online services you turn on. Update checks only ask GitHub for the version number and never send what you type; they go online only when you tap “Check for updates” or turn on “Check for updates automatically”, and new versions are installed by the system installer. Local Rime, handwriting and offline voice models run on the device.

column2: On-device input is handled by the open-source Rime engine. For optional services such as online voice, data handling depends on the provider you choose; please read their privacy policy.

column1: CyIME 默认使用本地输入与识别。主动启用在线语音或其他联网服务时，相应音频或文本会发送给您选择的服务商。手写贡献和贡献滑行轨迹须同意 CC0 1.0 才能向魔搭上传。手写包含题目、笔迹、时间、识别结果（如有）、机型、版本及随机编号。滑行只在「贡献滑行轨迹」页开启贡献时发送题目、布局、轨迹及随机编号，平时打字不记录。贡献样本可公开使用。在「贡献词库」页分享或上传时，只有列表里勾选的词、拼音和次数，用于改进 CyIME 词库。聊天语料页在本机列出学过的词句和最近的选词对照。分享或上传仅包含勾选的文字及该行显示的搭配次数或输入编码、当时的首选、方案和布局。上传至魔搭时另带独立随机贡献编号，用于改进词库、整句输入和联想。平时手写和打字的原文不会自动上传。
column2: CyIME uses on-device input and recognition by default. When you turn on online voice or other network services, the related audio or text is sent to the provider you choose. Handwriting and glide-path contributions require agreeing to CC0 1.0 before uploading to ModelScope. Handwriting includes prompts, strokes, timing, recognition results (if any), device model, version and a random ID. Glide data is only sent when contribution is turned on in “Contribute glide paths”, with prompts, layout, paths and a random ID; everyday typing isn't recorded. Contributed samples may be used publicly. When sharing or uploading from “Contribute dictionary”, only the ticked words, pinyin and counts in the list are sent, to improve CyIME's dictionary. The chat corpus page lists words and sentences learned on this device and recent selections. Sharing or uploading includes only the ticked text plus the pair count or input code shown on that row, the first candidate at the time, the scheme and the layout. Uploads to ModelScope also carry a separate random contribution ID, used to improve the dictionary, sentence input and prediction. What you normally handwrite and type is never uploaded automatically.
